note: The Malaysia Visa Offers + Perks listing at https://www.visa.com.my/en_my/visa-offers-and-perks/ is an Angular app. The HTML shell has no tiles until the page posts to the same-origin list at /offers/api/portal/portal/perks/. Use browser mode with a 30 second settle so that post can finish. Each tile is a vs-perk-card. The public detail JSON for one offer is /offers/api/offer/{id}?locale=en_my&siteId=www.visa.com.my on the same host. Off-domain hosts linked from these pages (including destinations.visa.com and cdn.visa.com) are reported and not crawled.
